page: Microsoft Azure F8ads_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system allocates 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, delivering 8 vCPUs clocked at up to 4.5 GHz. The CPU features 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, alongside support for instruction set extensions including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, and AES cryptography extensions.

The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing an even allocation of 4.0 GB per core. For high-speed temporary storage, it includes a local 944 GB NVMe SSD, while remaining capable of attaching Azure Premium Storage. The configuration does not include discrete hardware GPU accelerators.

Benchmark results highlight strong single-threaded throughput, driven by the 4.5 GHz maximum frequency. Single-core stress-ng tests, single-threaded gzip compression at 39.48 GB/sec, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression at 17.87 GB/sec all register in the top tier of evaluated cloud systems. Text generation throughput for small 135M language models also reaches the top 10% tier at 358.88 tokens per second. Multi-core performance metrics, such as stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU score (24,323.24), alongside memory bandwidth figures, fall within the middle 50% tier.

Because the server combines dedicated single-threaded compute cores with fast local NVMe storage and balanced memory, it offers efficient processing density for compute-bound tasks without requiring high-memory configurations. The Microsoft Azure F8ads_v7 is suited for compute-heavy workloads, single-threaded batch processing, fast data compression pipelines, static web serving, and database tasks requiring fast local scratch storage.
description: Microsoft Azure F8ads_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine featuring an 8-core AMD EPYC 9V45 processor operating at up to 4.5 GHz with a dedicated 1-to-1 core-to-thread ratio. It provides 32.0 GB of system memory (4.0 GB per vCPU) and a local 944 GB NVMe SSD for high-speed scratch space, without discrete GPUs. In synthetic benchmarks, the instance demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU throughput, top-tier single-threaded data compression, and strong small-model LLM generation speeds. Multi-core compute and memory bandwidth benchmark scores operate within the median tier. The instance offers resource efficiency for compute-focused architectures that benefit from fast clock speeds and integrated high-speed local disk storage, making it suitable for batch compression jobs, build pipelines, database caching, and web services.
